mod.name: SRO Catenary+ (Sawyer)
mod.author: quadub
mod.desc: v1.0. Stormworks Railway Overhaul with a Soviet / Russian style 25 kV overhead line (visual) on every track of the Sawyer mainland: concrete poles with insulated cantilevers, zigzagged contact wire on droppers, anchor sections with overlaps, tension weights, portals with lattice girders and working ladders, wires through truss bridges. Includes the whole base SRO (3D rails and sleepers on every railway tile, smoothed curves, kilometre posts, track graph raised by 28 cm): use it instead of SRO, not together with it.
